name: Ofcom Network Transparency Code (AI-Assisted Network Operations)
scope: UK-licensed telecommunications operators deploying AI in network planning, fault management, or customer-affecting automated decisions
summary: Requires operators to publish machine-readable evidence of the provenance, validation, and confidence of automated network decisions. Affected customer decisions (service quality, outage attribution, performance throttling) must carry an auditable PROV-O chain.

requirements.title: Competency-question coverage for network events
requirements.description: The ontology must answer the regulator's competency questions about asset ownership, event history, and observation provenance.

requirements.title: Asset–event linkage
requirements.description: Every network event must be associated with the affected asset.

requirements.title: Event participant attribution
requirements.description: Automated events must declare their initiating agent and any participating agents for customer-affecting decisions.

requirements.title: Confidence disclosure for automated decisions
requirements.description: Every AI observation affecting a customer must disclose a confidence score that an auditor can filter on.

requirements.title: Policy governance on customer-impacting events
requirements.description: Customer-affecting events must name the governing service-quality policy and its outcome.

requirements.title: Exchange readiness — machine-readable transparency artefact
requirements.description: Transparency disclosures must be available as JSON-LD with a documented context.

requirements.title: Provenance of the decision under audit
requirements.description: The decision identified in the audit must have a reconstructible PROV-O chain of depth at least 1.
